critical_code_review_comments: send_trial_nudge_now (subscriptions.py L1057) raises 400 on email failure AFTER already writing a renewal_reminder_log row with email_sent=false — the HQ UI sees a red toast but a false 'reminded' log entry lives on. Consider inserting the log AFTER the send succeeds, or only when the failure is downstream (e.g. Resend rate-limited).

run_renewal_reminders (subscriptions.py L1000) counts 'sent += 1 if log[email_sent] else 0' but 'failed += 0 if log[email_sent] else 1' — for tenants without owner_email it silently counts as failed with error 'no owner_email on tenant' and still writes a reminder-log row that blocks future retries for that (tenant, end_date, days_mark). If owner_email is added later, the tenant will never be re-nudged for that mark. Consider skipping log insert when there is no owner_email, or reset on owner_email change.

create_trial_pay_link (pay_links.py L271) uses PLAN_CATALOG['half_year'] as fallback which is INR-only. INR is enforced upstream ('_send_renewal_email' only reaches send_trial_ending_email for INR tenants), but the helper is public — if someone calls create_trial_pay_link for a USD tenant it would silently create an INR link. Add explicit INR guard or accept plan_key argument.

LeaderboardRevenue.jsx sendTrialNudge posts days = Math.max(0, r.days_remaining || 0). If a trial row is 'today' (0d) or 1d overdue the button will POST days=0 which the API happily accepts (ge=0) and the copy will read 'ends in 0 day(s)' — cosmetically odd. Consider clamping to at least 1 or switching wording to 'today/overdue'.
